book_title: Live the Life You Truly Want
author: Nancy Oelklaus
book_description: Live the Life You Truly Want is a collection of short, simple stories from my real life that illustrate how good life can be when, one day at a time, we practice having a peaceful state of mind. It's a book to pick up, read one brief story, spend a moment in reflection, set an intention, and go have a good day.
